FINDING 2 CONFIRMED, AND IT IS THE SUBSTANTIVE ONE. ledger/evidence/EV-GGM-79e710.yaml observation O-2 reads: 'Oracle C (incidence): SIMULABLE. The incidence check (does P_{i1}+...+P_{ir}=Q?) is fully checkable via group operations and equality tests (at most m group ops per query).' FINDING 3 CONFIRMED. The false premise is INHERITED, not original to KN-FIND-b7e091. EV-GGM-79e710.yaml carries in its assumptions list: 'End_{F_p}(E) = Z for generic prime-order prime-field curves (CM theory)', and states it again in observation O-3. The round must therefore examine EV-GGM-79e710 and DEC-20260804-3b4258, not the finding record alone -- correcting only KN-FIND-b7e091 would leave the same false premise standing in the evidence it rests on. Note the hedge 'generic', which is still wrong: End(E) strictly contains Z for EVERY elliptic curve over a finite field, generic or not, because Frobenius has degree p while [m] has degree m squared and a prime is never a square.
